text.description_html:
Brass Accents A05-P5351, 11-1/4" Arts and Crafts Door Pull

With the textured plate and square cut-outs, the Arts and Crafts Pull Plate has a rustic look. It is available in a wide array of finishes including the ever popular polished brass, satin nickel, and venetian bronze. The indents on the backplate helps to bring out the highlights of each of the available finishes. This door pull with plate measures 11-1/4 inches high and 2-7/8 inches wide, making it an impressive statement on any door.

Also Available: Arts and Crafts Push Plate

Specifications for Arts and Crafts Decorative Pull Plate

  • Plate Width: 2-7/8"
  • Plate Height: 11-1/4"
  • Pull Length: 6-1/4"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Material: Cast Brass

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.



***THIS ITEM IS DISCONTINUED, VERY LIMITED QUANTITIES AVAILABLE***
